name: strategy-factory
description: Develop ideas into decision-ready strategic cases while strengthening the user's strategic judgment.

interface.shortDescription: Develop ideas and practice strategic judgment.
interface.longDescription: A skills-only toolkit for sharpening ideas, researching frameworks and prior art, modeling value, designing experiments, forming narratives, and reviewing outcomes. Coaching keeps evidence, assumptions, and user decisions distinct.
defaultPrompt: Use strategy-factory to help me develop an idea, one substantive question at a time.
